profile_text.body:
Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) is a venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, California, founded in 2009. According to its website, the firm invests in bold founders, innovators, and entrepreneurs building the future through technology, operating under the philosophy that software is eating the world.

The held facts indicate that a16z has a significant legal exposure footprint, with 220 cases involving California law. The firm maintains a presence on theworldofai.org's reference site but has no tracked AI products, MCP servers, or SEC filings in the registry.
